context: This scene auto-triggers when the party smashes or pries open a coffin and finds a tetchy kobold, Bugthimble, caught looting the contents she’d tunneled in to pinch. The players have either dug here because a courier’s note promised “enough valuables to settle matters between us” for Nine‑Fingers, or they were digging up a grave for sport, so they expect the chest’s contents (or ownership). Bugthimble, wearing a face‑covering helmet, is defensive and insists she found the haul first, but she instantly softens and offers to give it up or bargain if the name Nine‑Fingers is invoked. The exchange can therefore turn to threats, a paid fee, or Bugthimble handing the crate over.
